name: Insider data theft
description: An employee or contractor copies or sends out data they should not.

steps.text: Involve HR and Legal before acting; investigate discreetly to avoid tipping off the subject.
Reconstruct data movement from DLP, USB, email and cloud-upload logs; quantify records and data types taken.
Suspend access in coordination with HR; collect the user's devices under chain of custody.
Seek recovery/deletion of the data (legal letter, account takedown requests).
Review least-privilege access and leaver/joiner controls.
